body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Haier displayed its 52-inch full HD LCD TV 'L52A18' during KES 2007, which features 6ms response speed, 500cd/m² brightness and 1,500:1 contrast ratio. Equipped with two HDMI connections and USB 2.0 slot, it can play full HD video via DVD player or PS3 as well as music and photo files stored in mp3 player or USB memory.
